post.description:
Find, match, and enrich people. Provide a `people` list (list mode) or a `filter` (filter mode) and compose the response with `select`.

Use `filter.query` for an advanced query with structured criteria. Beta users can use `filter.search` to describe who they are looking for in plain language and receive results ranked by relevance. Organization filters scope either approach and are optional with `search`. `query` and `search` cannot be combined.

On **v7 and earlier** this endpoint is synchronous: one call returns the people.

On **v8 and later** it is **asynchronous** in both modes. Send a `people` or `filter` body to start a background job — the response returns a `request_id` and `status: "pending"`, and no credits are charged yet (the request is validated and your balance pre-checked, so you still get a `400`/`402` up front). Then send `{ "request_id": "..." }` to the same endpoint to poll: you get `status` `pending`/`running` until it finishes, then `succeeded` (with the full `people`/`total` result) or `failed`. Credits are charged once, on the first `succeeded` poll; repeat polls report `credits_used: 0`. The async response adds `request_id` and `status` fields. On **v9**, pass a `file_name` on the kickoff request to receive downloadable file metadata instead of inline `people` when the job succeeds. Poll with `request_id` alone.

jobs_count_rollup.title: Jobs Count Rollup
jobs_count_rollup.description: Total job posts at the organization including all subsidiaries (hierarchy rollup). Consistent with the entity-metric `job_post_count` and the denominator of `job_post_concentration`.

jobs_count_no_rollup.title: Jobs Count No Rollup
jobs_count_no_rollup.description: Job posts attributed to this organization's own records only, excluding subsidiaries. Consistent with the `job_post_count_no_rollup` entity metric.

teams_count_rollup.title: Teams Count Rollup
teams_count_rollup.description: Total teams at the organization including all subsidiaries (hierarchy rollup). Consistent with the entity-metric `team_count`; use this rather than the legacy `teams_count` (own-records only, different source) as the denominator for team-share math against entity metrics.

teams_count_no_rollup.title: Teams Count No Rollup
teams_count_no_rollup.description: Teams attributed to this organization's own records only, excluding subsidiaries. Consistent with the `team_count_no_rollup` entity metric.

people_count_rollup.title: People Count Rollup
people_count_rollup.description: People tracked by Sumble at the organization including all subsidiaries (hierarchy rollup). Consistent with the entity-metric `people_count` and the denominator of `people_concentration`. Not the same as `employee_count` (LinkedIn-reported headcount).

people_count_no_rollup.title: People Count No Rollup
people_count_no_rollup.description: People attributed to this organization's own records only, excluding subsidiaries. Consistent with the `people_count_no_rollup` entity metric.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status of the organization: 'active', or 'closed' (permanently ceased operations — shut down, dissolved, or bankrupt with no successor). Returned when requested via `select.attributes`; costs 1 credit like any other paid baseline attribute. Advanced-query filter results exclude closed organizations unless the request sets `include_closed`. More statuses (e.g. 'acquired_absorbed') may be added over time.

status_reason.title: Status Reason
status_reason.description: For a non-'active' status, the free-text reason for that determination. Null for active organizations. Returned when requested via `select.attributes`; costs 1 credit like any other paid baseline attribute.

account_status.title: Account Status
account_status.description: CRM relationship between the org and the user's account: 'customer' (a customer account in the user's CRM), 'prospect' (tracked in CRM but not a customer), or 'not_in_crm' (no CRM record). Free (no credit cost). Only populated when the user's account has a linked CRM seat; omitted for other users even if requested.

funding_total_raised.title: Funding Total Raised
funding_total_raised.description: Total funding raised across all rounds, in whole USD. LLM-extracted from SEC filings and web search; approximate, and may be unconverted for non-USD rounds.

funding_valuation.title: Funding Valuation
funding_valuation.description: Most recent post-money valuation, in whole USD. LLM-extracted; approximate.

funding_last_round_raised.title: Funding Last Round Raised
funding_last_round_raised.description: Amount raised in the latest funding round, in whole USD. LLM-extracted; approximate.

funding_last_round_type.title: Funding Last Round Type
funding_last_round_type.description: Latest funding round type, e.g. seed, series_a, private_equity.

funding_last_round_date.title: Funding Last Round Date
funding_last_round_date.description: Date of the latest funding round (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Sumble organization slug, the key in the organization's web URL (`https://sumble.com/orgs/<slug>`) and on the organizations endpoint.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Start of the person's current role (YYYY-MM).

sumble_url.title: Sumble Url
sumble_url.description: Link to the organization's Sumble profile page.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: List of organizations to resolve and enrich. Mutually exclusive with `filter`.

filter.description: Advanced query selecting the organizations to return. Mutually exclusive with `organizations`.

include_closed.title: Include Closed
include_closed.description: Filter mode only: include organizations marked permanently closed (`status` = 'closed') in the results — they are excluded by default. Request the `status` / `status_reason` attributes to identify which results are closed. Not valid with `organizations` (direct lookups always resolve closed organizations).

select.description: Dictates exactly which columns are returned.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: (v9 only) Return a downloadable file instead of inline `organizations`. Must end in `.csv`, `.xlsx` for Excel, or `.json`.

order_by_column.title: Order By Column
order_by_column.description: Column to order by (filter mode only). Parameterized sorts (this endpoint only): `people_concentration` and `people_count_growth_1y` sort by the named job function's people metrics — the all-time fraction of the org's tracked people in it, and its current YoY people growth % (latest month vs. one year earlier; orgs without growth data sort last) respectively — and require `order_by_job_function`. `job_post_concentration` sorts by the all-time fraction of the org's job posts matching `order_by_advanced_query`, which it requires. `source_data_url` is omitted for all three, since the listing page cannot reproduce their ordering.

order_by_direction.title: Order By Direction
order_by_direction.description: Direction to order by (filter mode only).

order_by_job_function.title: Order By Job Function
order_by_job_function.description: Job function whose people metrics drive the sort. Required with (and only valid with) `order_by_column="people_concentration"` or `order_by_column="people_count_growth_1y"`.

order_by_advanced_query.title: Order By Advanced Query
order_by_advanced_query.description: Advanced query whose matching job posts form the sort numerator. Required with (and only valid with) `order_by_column="job_post_concentration"`. Allowed fields: technology, technology_category, job_function, project, job_level, country. Both the matching and total job counts are all-time.

match_source.title: Match Source
match_source.description: Filter mode only. Which evidence an organization may match the `filter` on. `any` (default) matches on either job posts or its employees' LinkedIn/Coresignal profiles: the skills they list, and where they are based. `job_post` restricts matches to job-post evidence only, so an org that matches solely through its employees is excluded, such as one whose employees list the technology but whose job posts never mention it, or one with staff in the `country` location but no job posts there. Applies to all job-side filters (technology, job function, `country`, etc.).

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Organizations returned by the request. Empty when `file_name` was provided; download the rows from `file` instead.

file.description: (v9 only) Download metadata for the file requested with `file_name`.

people.title: People
people.description: List of people to resolve and enrich. One result row per entry, in input order. Mutually exclusive with `filter`.

filter.title: Filters
filter.description: Organization scope and an advanced `query` or plain-language `search` to select people. Scope is optional with `search`. Mutually exclusive with `people`.

select.description: Dictates exactly which attributes are returned.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of people to return (filter mode only; ignored when `people` is provided).

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Number of results to skip (filter mode only; ignored when `people` is provided).

requested_total.title: Requested Total
requested_total.description: Maximum people for the whole search, across pages. Only available with `filter.search`; defaults to `limit`. Set this before the first page and keep it unchanged when paging with `limit` and `offset`.

order_by_column.title: Order By Column
order_by_column.description: Column to order by (filter mode only): `start_date` (current role start), `job_level` (seniority rank), or `person_score`. `person_score` sorts people by how well they match your ideal customer profile (ICP) and includes — and charges for — the `person_score` attribute on every row; it requires the filter to resolve to exactly one organization and an ICP configured for your account, and only supports descending order. Default: Sumble's standard people ordering.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: (v8 only) Id of a previously started async request (returned by the kickoff call). Provide this alone to poll for the status and result.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: (v9 only) Return the completed result as a downloadable file instead of inline `people`. Must be a filename ending in `.csv`, `.xlsx` for Excel, or `.json`. Provide this only when starting a request, not when polling it.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: (v8 only) Id of the async request. Poll POST /people with this id to retrieve the status and result.

status.title: Status
status.description: (v8 only) Request status: pending, running, succeeded, or failed. Null on the synchronous (<= v7) endpoint.

people.title: People
people.description: People returned by the request. Empty when `file_name` was provided; download the rows from `file` instead.

matched_count.title: Matched Count
matched_count.description: List mode only: how many input entries resolved to a Sumble person.

file.description: (v9 only) Download metadata for the file requested with `file_name`.

job_post_used_count.title: Job Post Used Count
job_post_used_count.description: technology only. Number of the org's job posts that list this technology as actively used (rather than merely mentioned). Scoped to the same `since` window as job_post_count when set. None for non-technology entities.

job_post_concentration.title: Job Post Concentration
job_post_concentration.description: advanced_query only. Fraction (0-1) of the org's job posts matching the query. Scoped to the same `since` window as job_post_count when set. None for unresolved orgs or orgs with no job posts.

people_concentration.title: People Concentration
people_concentration.description: job_function only. Fraction (0-1) of the org's tracked people in this job function: people_count / total people in the org. Scoped to the same `since` window as people_count when set. None for unresolved orgs or orgs with no tracked people.

job_post_count_no_rollup.title: Job Post Count No Rollup
job_post_count_no_rollup.description: technology, job_function, and project selections only. Same as `job_post_count` but excluding records attributed to subsidiaries (the organization's own records only). All-time only — not affected by `since`.

team_count_no_rollup.title: Team Count No Rollup
team_count_no_rollup.description: technology, job_function, and project selections only. Same as `team_count` but excluding records attributed to subsidiaries. All-time only — not affected by `since`.

people_count_no_rollup.title: People Count No Rollup
people_count_no_rollup.description: technology and job_function selections only. Same as `people_count` but excluding records attributed to subsidiaries. All-time only — not affected by `since`.

type.title: Type
type.description: The entity type to enrich against.

term.title: Term
term.description: The entity term: a technology name, job function, project, category, or advanced query string.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Metric names valid for `type`, or "all". Required for every type.

granularity.title: Granularity
granularity.description: `technology_category` only (required there, disallowed elsewhere). `aggregate` rolls the category up into one set of counts; `exploded` decomposes into per-component-technology counts.

since.title: Since
since.description: Scopes job_post_count, job_post_used_count, team_count, and people_count to activity since this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Does not affect people_count_growth_1y. No-rollup metrics are all-time only: with `since` set they are excluded from `metrics: "all"` and rejected if requested explicitly.

organization_id.title: Organization Id
organization_id.description: Sumble organization id of the employer, when Sumble has it; usable as `filter.organization_ids`. Null otherwise.

name.title: Name
name.description: Employer name as it appears on the person's profile.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Sumble organization slug of the employer, when Sumble has it; the key in the organization's web URL (`https://sumble.com/orgs/<slug>`) and on the organizations endpoint. Null otherwise.

organization_ids.title: Organization Ids
organization_ids.description: Sumble organization ids to search within. Provide this and/or `organization_list_id` to scope an advanced query or search. Organization scope is required unless `search` is provided.

organization_list_id.title: Organization List Id
organization_list_id.description: Id of one of your saved organization lists (see /organization-lists) whose organizations to search within. Combined with `organization_ids` when both are provided.

query.title: Advanced query
query.description: Match people using a structured query expression over job functions, technologies, job levels, locations, and more. Requires an organization scope. Cannot be combined with `search`.

search.title: Search
search.description: Describe who you are looking for in plain language. Results are ranked by relevance. For example: 'Own Salesforce administration and revenue operations'. Available in limited beta. Organization scope is optional; omit it to search everyone. Cannot be combined with `query`, `order_by_column` or the `person_score` attribute.

include_past_employers.title: Include Past Employers
include_past_employers.description: Available in limited beta. When true, the organizations in scope also match people who used to work there. Requires `search`.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Person-level attributes to include, or 'all' for every attribute-priced attribute. Off by default. 'all' excludes contact attributes (email, phone) and profile attributes (experience, summary), which must be requested explicitly, and includes `person_score` only when it is available (filter mode with exactly one organization in scope and an ICP configured for your account) — otherwise it is skipped, not an error. When `person_score` is included and no `order_by_column` is set, results are ordered by it. Note that 'all' grows — and its cost grows — as new attributes are added to the endpoint.

related_people.description: Also return people related to each matched person, up or down the org hierarchy. Relationships are inferred from org structure and seniority (technology, job function, team, location and job-level similarity), not actual reporting lines. Only available in match mode (`people`), for at most 25 people per request. Each related person returned costs 1 credit.

email.title: Email
email.description: Revealed work email (match mode only). The first successful reveal per person costs 10 credits; repeat reveals while active are free.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Revealed phone number (match mode only). The first successful reveal per person costs 80 credits; repeat reveals while active are free.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.description: Technologies from the skills on the person's LinkedIn profile, normalized to Sumble's technology catalog. The slug can be used in `filter.query` (technology EQ '<slug>'). Empty when none of the profile's skills map to a known technology.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: The person's LinkedIn-style role history, newest first. Each role's `employer` is shaped like `current_employer`, with the Sumble organization id and link filled in when Sumble knows the organization. At most 200 people per match-mode request. Empty when the profile lists no roles.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The person's profile summary ('About' section), as they wrote it. At most 200 people per match-mode request. Null when the profile has none.

person_score.description: How well the person matches your ideal customer profile (ICP), 0-100, with a per-feature breakdown. Priced like other paid attributes. Filter mode only; selecting it explicitly requires the filter to resolve to exactly one organization and an ICP configured for your account (`attributes: "all"` skips it instead when unavailable). Included automatically when sorting with `order_by_column="person_score"`.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Role end month, YYYY-MM; null for a current role.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Role length as shown on the profile, e.g. '2 years 3 months'.

description.title: Description
description.description: The person's own description of the role, when they wrote one.

#/components/schemas/PersonExperienceRol.title: PersonExperienceRole
#/components/schemas/PersonExperienceRol.description: One role from the person's LinkedIn-style experience history.

person_id.title: Person Id
person_id.description: Person id on Sumble. When set, it identifies the person directly and `linkedin_url`/`email` are ignored.

linkedin_url.title: Linkedin Url
linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the person, e.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/<slug>'. Entries whose URL is not a profile URL come back unmatched. Takes precedence over `email`.

email.title: Email
email.description: Work email of the person, resolved via reverse enrichment. Costs 20 extra credits when it resolves to a returned person; emails that don't resolve come back unmatched, free. Only used when neither `person_id` nor `linkedin_url` is provided.

name.title: Name
name.description: Full name of the person, used only to disambiguate the reverse-enrichment lookup when resolving by `email`. Not an identifier on its own — an entry with just a name is rejected — and ignored for `person_id`/`linkedin_url` entries. Supplying it materially improves resolution for addresses whose local part isn't a parseable name (e.g. `firstname@company.com`), and lets the matcher recognise people whose email is at a former employer.

input.description: The input entry this row corresponds to (list mode only).

person_id.title: Person Id
person_id.description: Absent when the input entry didn't resolve to a person.

sumble_url.title: Sumble Url
sumble_url.description: Link to the person's Sumble profile page.

attributes.description: The requested person-level attributes; absent when none resolve.

value.title: Value
value.description: How well the person matches your ideal customer profile (ICP), 0-100. Sum of the three contributions below.

skill_contribution.title: Skill Contribution
skill_contribution.description: Points from technologies the person uses that match your ICP.

job_function_contribution.title: Job Function Contribution
job_function_contribution.description: Points from the person's job function matching your ICP.

seniority_contribution.title: Seniority Contribution
seniority_contribution.description: Points from the person's job level (seniority).

matched_features.title: Matched Features
matched_features.description: The matched technologies and job functions behind the skill and job-function contributions, highest contribution first.

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: Points of the 0-100 score attributable to this feature.

managers.title: Managers
managers.description: Inferred managers; present only when requested.

direct_reports.title: Direct Reports
direct_reports.description: Inferred direct reports; present only when requested.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Person-level attributes to include for each related person, or 'all' for every attribute available here. Contact attributes (email, phone) and `person_score` are not available here; `confidence` (the inferred relationship's score breakdown) is only available here.

score.title: Score
score.description: How strongly this person relates to the source person (people endpoint) or job posting (jobs endpoint), 0-1. Sum of the five contributions below. Measures similarity on shared features (technologies, job functions, teams, locations, job titles) — unrelated to the ICP-based `person_score` attribute.

technology_contribution.title: Technology Contribution
technology_contribution.description: Share from technologies shared with the source.

title_similarity_contribution.title: Title Similarity Contribution
title_similarity_contribution.description: Share from semantic similarity between job titles.

matched_features.title: Matched Features
matched_features.description: The specific matched features behind the contributions, highest contribution first.

name.title: Name
name.description: The matched feature's name; for title_similarity, the related person's own job title.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Null for location and title_similarity matches.

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: Share of the confidence score attributable to this feature.

sumble_url.title: Sumble Url
sumble_url.description: Link to the person's Sumble profile page.

confidence.description: Why this person was returned: confidence score (0-1) with per-category and per-feature breakdowns. Present when the `confidence` attribute is requested. Not the ICP-based `person_score`.

attributes.description: The requested person-level attributes; absent when none resolve.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Baseline company attributes to include. Off by default.
